import json, os, sys, urllib.request
raw = os.environ["BLAND_API_KEY"].strip()
if raw.startswith("{"):
    p = json.loads(raw); raw = next((p[k] for k in ("api_key", "key", "value") if p.get(k)), raw)
PW = "94abad8b-fbe2-4e67-9c64-d9b586dd2653"
req = urllib.request.Request("https://api.bland.ai/v1/pathway/%s/version/123" % PW, headers={"Authorization": raw, "Content-Type": "application/json", "User-Agent": "mybcat-cli"})
with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=60) as r:
    body = json.loads(r.read().decode())
graph = body.get("data") if isinstance(body.get("data"), dict) else body
live_prompt = None
for n in graph.get("nodes") or []:
    if isinstance(n, dict) and str(n.get("id")) == "n_goal_ask":
        live_prompt = (n.get("data") or {}).get("prompt")
if not isinstance(live_prompt, str):
    sys.exit("BUILD_FAIL: could not extract live n_goal_ask prompt")
lines = live_prompt.split("\n")
trimmed = "\n".join(ln.rstrip() for ln in lines)
for old, new in zip(lines, trimmed.split("\n")):
    if new != old.rstrip():
        sys.exit("BUILD_FAIL: visible text changed during trim")
if "\u6c38\u660c" not in trimmed:
    sys.exit("BUILD_FAIL: Ankit's new welcome copy (Chinese business name) missing after trim")
if "OPENING" not in trimmed:
    sys.exit("BUILD_FAIL: OPENING sentinel missing from prompt")
if len(trimmed) > 2200:
    sys.exit("BUILD_FAIL: prompt still %d chars after whitespace trim (cap 2200) — wording must shrink, needs Ankit" % len(trimmed))
draft = json.load(open("/home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workR26/gl-round26-fix/pathway-goalloop-draft.json"))
hit = 0
for n in draft.get("nodes") or []:
    if isinstance(n, dict) and str(n.get("id")) == "n_goal_ask":
        n.setdefault("data", {})["prompt"] = trimmed
        hit += 1
if hit != 1:
    sys.exit("BUILD_FAIL: expected exactly 1 n_goal_ask in draft, found %d" % hit)
json.dump(draft, open("draft-v124.json", "w"), indent=1)
print("BUILD_OK live_len=%d trimmed_len=%d" % (len(live_prompt), len(trimmed)))
